{{Top|leg}}
'''Choarn''' were blue [[Eel/Legends|eel]]-like scavengers with excellent sense of smell. Indigenous to [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], these creatures were known to resort to [[cannibalism]]. They ranged in size from 1 to 8 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. Their gaping maws featured rows upon rows of sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. They were driven into killing frenzies by the scent of [[Blood/Legends|blood]] to the point that blood-crazed packs of choarns have been known to batter themselves to death against the transparent windows of floating [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] cities. Despite their aggressive behavior, the Quarren have been reluctant to keep choarn populations down around their cities as they are an important element of the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] ecosystem, not to mention a staple of Quarren cuisine.<ref name="Death">''[[Death in the Undercity]]''</ref>
